'''Suena''' is a [[Papuan languages|Papuan language]] spoken in [[Morobe Province]], in the "tail" of [[Papua New Guinea]]. It is part of the Binanderean family of the [[Trans–New Guinea languages|Trans–New Guinea]] phylum of languages.

The Yarawi people spoke Suena during most of the 20th century, but may have switched to [[Binandere language|Binandere]].
